name: iact_hyades_ctao_alpha_giants
label: The four Hyades giants on the CTAO-North alpha array (4 LSTs + 9 MSTs) at Stage I and II with the real NewEra giant models (log g 2.5): the sidelobes to 560 m and the gravity / metallicity profile tests
notes: Companion to iact_hyades_magic_lst1: the 68-560 m alpha baselines sample the second to the twelfth lobe of a 2.3-2.7 mas disk at 425 nm; the MST pairs' lower S/N per pair is repaid by 78 baselines.

Real giant models from the 2026-11-01 NewEra cool-giant box: each target's own atmosphere.model (epsilon Tau lte04900-2.50-0.0; gamma, delta1, theta1 Tau lte04800-2.50-0.0; no campaign-wide stand_in). compare_models brackets the gravity (log g 2.0 and 3.0 at 4800 K), the metallicity (4900 K / 2.5 at +0.5), and repeats the 2026-10 stand-ins (5000 K dwarf and supergiant) so the old bracket can be compared with the real profile.
Companion of iact_hyades_ctao_alpha (the 2026-10-28 stand-in run); docs/hyades_ld.md compares the two.
